prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Pick Your Ideal Desktop Companion", "Select from our live dynamic companion archetypes or build your custom companion."]
1: ["Verify Desktop Pet Visibility", "Look around your screen edges to confirm your companion has rendered successfully.", "Pet Is Visible"]
2: ["Practice Interacting With Your Companion", "Try sending a test message to learn basic commands and interaction gestures.", "Type a greeting to your pet...", "Send Test Greeting"]
3: ["Your Desktop Pet Command Center", "Quickly review essential desktop shortcuts and companion controls before entering your workspace."]
4: ["See Companions In Action", "Preview how animated pets interact directly on your desktop screen.", "Choose My Path"]
5: ["Signing in reconnects your existing account and automatically restores your active desktop companions."]
6: ["Adoption Certificate & Bonus Perk", "Your companion is registered! Claim your exclusive starter desktop item reward.", "Bonus Accessory Unlocked"]
7: ["Configuring Desktop Environment", "Setting up graphics render buffers and desktop overlay permissions..."]
8: ["Select Your Desktop Pet Journey", "Pick an instant ready-to-play companion or create a personalized pet from your own photos."]
9: ["Enable desktop notifications to receive alerts when your pet wants to interact."]
